results.explanation:
Numbers check out against the tool results. PEGGED 78, the two parent ids, cancel symmetry 0.972, 6657 filled before the opposite trade against an opposite fill of 1118 at 14:27:01.082, price_move -3.5, reversion 0, round trip 0.022, OTR 7.7, cancel ratio 0.96, depth 2554.67 and spread 2.32 all match. The eight fills on O-00026838 (99 + 6×381 + 292 = 2677) also match.

The CLOSE_FP rests on the closure standard. The supported explanation is algorithmic re-pricing (pegged children of two parents, symmetric cancels). Genuine execution is shown because 6657 filled before the opposite trade, more than the 1118 opposite quantity. Feature (b) is absent: no favourable move, no reversion, round trip about 0. Market making, risk cut, news, iceberg and stop-out are each ruled out with a cited tool fact.

Weaknesses:
- 'Opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as not matched. The SELL child O-00027007 was in fact partially filled for 1118 and its remainder cancelled about 3s later. The real point is that this is ordinary order management, so the indicator wording is loose.
- The report cites same_side_fill_share 0.0643 (below the one-tenth rule of thumb) without saying that the alternative test (more than the opposite-side quantity) is the one met.
- Fat finger is dismissed via E1 (order types and parents) rather than a direct fact.
- The sequence of the later BUY fills (14:26:29–31) is not laid out, so a reviewer must partly reconstruct it.
- The closing message claims a first submission was rejected for a field-name error, but no such rejection appears in the conversation. This is an unsupported statement, though it is outside the report.

Overall the report is solid but has loose indicator wording and minor gaps.
results.label: Good
